Want to see it in action first? Open statustrio.lingai.net to simulate every icon state in your browser.

> Status Trio is an independent project and is not affiliated with Apple.

• One icon, three signals — battery, Wi-Fi, and volume share one icon in the menu bar, the Dock, or both, and a Bluetooth device that is playing can take the middle spot with its own symbol.

Describe a materials research task. MatOS assembles the scientific assets it needs, runs them as a stateful, checkable workflow, and turns every run into better assets for the next one.

# Contents

• What's in This Edition

# What is MatOS?

MatOS is an agent operating system for materials research. Materials studies run for days, cross literature, computation and experiment, and keep changing as results arrive. Agents for this work have to take on new data and software, keep long tasks on track, and remember what earlier tasks taught them. MatOS builds these capabilities around versioned scientific assets: data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles and workflows.

Research tasks drive the stateful adaptive workflow, the layered scientific asset graph supplies composable capabilities, and execution traces and user feedback become reviewed asset revisions that return to the graph.

# BehaviorTree.CPP 4.9

This C++ 17 library provides a framework to create BehaviorTrees. It was designed to be flexible, easy to use, reactive and fast.

Even if our main use-case is robotics, you can use this library to build AI for games, or to replace Finite State Machines.

There are a few features that make BehaviorTree.CPP unique, when compared to other implementations:

• It makes asynchronous Actions, i.e. non-blocking, a first-class citizen.

• You can build reactive behaviors that execute multiple Actions concurrently (orthogonality).

• Trees are defined using a Domain Specific scripting language (based on XML), and can be loaded at run-time; in other words, even if written in C++, the morphology of the Trees is _not_ hard-coded.

• You can statically link your custom TreeNodes or convert them into plugins

and load them at run-time.

• It provides a type-safe and flexible mechanism to do Dataflow between

Nodes of the Tree.

repos.readme_excerpt:
# Fedora 45 Post Install Guide

Things to do after installing Fedora 45

# RPM Fusion

• Fedora has disabled the repositories for a lot of free and non-free .rpm packages by default. Follow this if you want to use non-free software like Steam, Discord and some multimedia codecs etc. As a general rule of thumb it is advised to do this to get access to many mainstream useful programs.

• Enable third party repositories by pasting the following into the terminal:

• sudo dnf install https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm

• also while you're at it, install app-stream metadata by:

• sudo dnf install -y rpmfusion-free-appstream-data rpmfusion-nonfree-appstream-data

# Update

• Go into the software center and click on update. Alternatively, you can do:

• sudo dnf -y update
